title: The noun decides: szép park, nagy kert

sections.title: Which ending?
sections.content: Choose *-ba* or *-be* by the vowels of the noun, not by the adjective. The adjective may have front vowels while the noun has back vowels, or the other way round. In *a szép park*, *szép* is front but *park* is back, so the ending is *-ba*: *a szép parkba*. In *a nagy kert*, *nagy* is back but *kert* is front, so the ending is *-be*: *a nagy kertbe*.

items.english: I am going to the beautiful park.
Károly is going to the big garden.
Anna is going to the new school.
Dad is going to the big city.

sections.content: The same holds for *-ban/-ben*: *a szép parkban*, *a nagy kertben*. If you are unsure, cover the adjective and look at the noun alone. *Város* has the vowels *á* and *o*, so it takes *-ba*.
